note: Authorities checked by the planner against legislation.gov.uk and the law reports on 6 Nov 2026 (the same ones used on the class-task website). Only these count as verified in the demo.

authorities.name: Salomon v A Salomon & Co Ltd
authorities.principle: a company is a separate legal person from its members

authorities.name: Hedley Byrne & Co Ltd v Heller & Partners Ltd
authorities.principle: a duty of care can arise for a careless statement where the maker assumes responsibility and the other party reasonably relies on it

authorities.name: Partnership Act 1890
authorities.principle: in Scotland a firm is a legal person distinct from its partners

authorities.name: Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2000
authorities.principle: two or more persons must subscribe the incorporation document

authorities.name: Companies Act 2006
authorities.principle: a private company must have at least one director

authorities.name: Companies Act 2006
authorities.principle: directors must act within powers, promote the company's success, use independent judgment and reasonable care, and avoid conflicts
